top3.headline: Five small open models matched a frontier harness on hard coding tests
top3.whyItMatters: Teams can get strong agent results from cheap open models, with every run logged for audit.

top3.headline: Epic ships an official plugin letting Claude Code drive Unreal Editor
top3.whyItMatters: Major creative tools now ship agent control themselves, so agent skills become a vendor feature.

top3.headline: Agent fleets now hit GitHub's 5,000 requests per hour user limit
top3.whyItMatters: Platform limits built for one human per account will cap how far your agents can scale.

items.title: Matt Pocock pitches Sandcastle v1 as an agent software factory
items.takeaway: Draft pitch, not a release: harnesses, sandboxes, durable runs, Slack approvals, skills as functions.
items.soWhat: Builders want agent tooling that packages review, specs and approvals as reusable parts.

items.title: Agent fleets now hit GitHub's 5,000 requests per hour user limit
items.takeaway: After clearing review and CI bottlenecks, Kun Chen says GitHub's per-user API limit is the next wall.
items.soWhat: Plan for platform rate limits before scaling agents that all act under one account.

items.title: Epic ships an official plugin letting Claude Code drive Unreal Editor
items.takeaway: Hundreds of editor tools over MCP across 30+ toolsets, listed in Anthropic's official plugin marketplace.
items.soWhat: Creative software makers are building agent control in, not waiting for third parties.

items.title: Five small open models matched a frontier harness on hard coding tests
items.takeaway: Memdoor's file-based team of Qwen agents scored 9.8 of 10 on ten hard problems, at about $0.39 per run.
items.soWhat: Multi-agent setups on open models can rival costly ones, though ten problems is a small test.

items.title: AI agents now steer a radio telescope from plain-language requests
items.takeaway: NVIDIA and SETI Institute agents calibrate and analyze 2.4 Tbps of live data on site at the Allen Telescope Array.
items.soWhat: Agents are moving from software tasks to running physical instruments in real time.
